source_scope: One ProShares dividend-growth US equity ETF; independent issuer, not a broad-market or cross-issuer aggregate.
calculation: (current shares outstanding - previous US trading session shares outstanding) * current NAV; shares column is in thousands and is converted to individual shares. Zero estimates are not reported cash flow; no missing rows treated as zero.

split_screen.history_note: May 27 and 28 NAV and share counts are on a comparable scale around the listed split in this current vintage, consistent with adjusted history. Do not apply the split factor again without validating raw versus adjusted history; exclude split-crossing rows in this pilot.

quality_notes: All five adjacent-session pairs reconciled issuer Prior NAV to previous session NAV.
Latest issuer row at retrieval was Nov 25; Nov 27 is not zero or inferred.
Published Shares Outstanding has thousand-share granularity in this extract. NAV-based creations are not published actual monetary flows.
